message.content: {"caption":"VERA’s diagram shows how verified environments support iterative agent and harness training, alongside benchmark scores across six rounds.","description":"A composite research figure. The upper workflow turns environment synthesis into a verified environment through LLM-generated auto rubrics, agent judging, and replay before scaling. The lower workflow shows VERA co-evolving an agent and its harness: benchmarking and attribution produce reports and target stages, while reward and harness verifiers check updates in alternating rounds. On the right are two line charts, with dashed SFT baselines and solid VERA results for rounds R0–R5. The upper chart compares SFT with VERA-CoWork-9B; the lower compares SFT with VERA-Med-9B.
